description: Return EVERY AETumi catalog asset for one exact industry, as a complete paged list rather than a ranked search. Accepted industry values: Technology, E-commerce, Biotech · Science, Web3 & Crypto, Automotive, Food & Beverage, Luxury · Lifestyle, F&B · Beverage, Logistics · Transport. Each item carries id, title, category, industry, price, tags, live demo url and whether editable source is included; the result also carries the total and a pagination cursor. Use this when you want the full inventory for an industry you already know. If you only have keywords, or want ranking across industries, use search_3d_web_assets. Note this covers COMMERCIAL assets; for AETumi Labs reference experiences by industry use filter_by_industry instead. Read-only, no authentication, no side effects; returns public catalog metadata.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

industry.description: One exact industry from the list in this tool description, e.g. Technology. Matched exactly (case-insensitive); for keywords use search_3d_web_assets.

limit.description: How many assets to return, 1-50, default 20.

name: filter_assets_by_industry

nextCursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

results.description: Every catalog asset for that industry, one page at a time.

title: List catalog assets by industry
